Public macOS speech runtime preparation

The public source excludes the previous local dylibs. native:mac:build first
downloads the pinned official sherpa-onnx v1.12.29 universal2 shared NO-TTS
release, verifies the published archive SHA256, and keeps its arm64 slices.
Source commit: 3595893df30c2e3cd1b407d51de29dd532c47b86
Source: https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/tree/v1.12.29
Recipe: scripts/open-source/prepare-speech.py
Archive SHA256: a6149e3bcfce6d9c45dc7bb67f807af553f5dc48ba0268bcb364bb369933dfb6
Per-library hashes and the actual download source are written to PUBLIC-RUNTIME.json.

sherpa-onnx code: Apache License 2.0
Copyright (c) 2023 Xiaomi Corporation and contributors
Full text: LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt in this directory.
The NO-TTS build excludes the unused piper/espeak-ng speech-synthesis engine.
Upstream ASR dependencies retain their original notices and licensing; pinned
source/build recipes are in the above upstream source and its cmake directory.

The optional SenseVoice INT8 model is not included in the source snapshot.
Download source: https://www.modelscope.cn/models/pengzhendong/sherpa-onnx-sense-voice-zh-en-ja-ko-yue
Its upstream page declares Apache License 2.0. The application pins model and
token hashes; recognition audio is processed locally.

Windows NuGet org.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx 1.13.5 is a separate runtime build. Its top
level Apache metadata does not prove the terms of all compiled components.
Inspect the restored platform libraries, any TTS/GPL components, full notices
and matching source during the still-pending Windows packaging acceptance.
